scope.summary: BkFace integration test (spec 13.23 acceptance; AREQ-007/010, PREQ-030): the ARKit-52 set drives archetype faces through a glTF round-trip (names plus deformation samples verified), arousal expressions layer with a viseme track on an archetype face including extreme-identity re-solved expressions, and the face config replays deterministically from the ledger with Argus captures persisted.
acceptance_criteria: End to end: archetype faces (including identity extremes) export via glTF with ARKit-52 morph targets; the round-trip re-import verifies names and MeshComparator-checked deformation samples.
Layering: arousal expressions compose over a viseme track on an archetype face with no evaluation conflicts; moan/gasp reserved visemes participate.
Expression correctives (MT-580) are active on an extreme-identity archetype and the composite passes mesh-quality gates.
Ledger replay reconstructs the face config with deterministic re-evaluation; Argus captures of the layered composite persist as evidence rows.
scope.risk_if_missed: The glTF round-trip with layered arousal expressions plus visemes is BkFace's named acceptance surface; without it, face MTs pass individually while the composed export story - the part users actually consume - remains unproven.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
